Adapted files (MPL-2.0):
third_party/GBADotnet.Core/src/Rom/EReader.cs
third_party/GBADotnet.Core/src/Rom/EReaderDotCode.cs

AetherBoy changes: C# port, bounded FIFO and owned card buffers, digital RAW/
packed-dot formats only, bounded register reads, serial read-byte wrap, scheduled
Game Pak IRQ, reset/cancel, complete versioned peripheral state, input validation,
late card insertion while firmware is already waiting for the next scan.
No firmware or commercial card payloads are included.

Corresponding modified source is distributed in the AetherBoy source tree:
https://github.com/VoltexModz/AetherBoy
Distributors must make the corresponding covered source available under MPL-2.0
and preserve these notices. The remainder of the GBADotnet directory retains its
existing license; these two files are not relicensed as MIT.
